recap.text: Osvaldo appears on the board as a crawler. In the wreck of the Masquerade, he takes a memorial crystal off Queen Imogen. Prepotente goes after him for it.

Osvaldo is a level-60 Curupira ranger and number eight on the top ten. While Carl lay unconscious, Osvaldo fought with a crawler named Burcu and Prepotente. Bianca ate Osvaldo's hawk, Gimli, and Osvaldo holds a memorial crystal that Carl and Prepotente have quests to take.

Osvaldo rides it out in the woods with a group called Team Flamengo. He holds Apito's memorial crystal, which looks like a giant rainbow visible from a long way off. The rainbow tells the Madness army where Carl's group is standing, and the army calls in Prepotente's forces for backup.

Osvaldo, a level seventy-two Curupira, rides Bruna the Slaughter Gnu with Filipe L and a dwarf mercenary. He collects memorial crystals for his god Tupa, giving one to Prepotente and carrying Ysalte's. He tells Carl they are not friends and refuses a deal on the tenth floor. Britney eliminates Osvaldo at the portals and takes Ysalte's crystal.

beats.headline: He takes Imogen's crystal
beats.text: New name on the board. Osvaldo, crawler. In the wreck of the Masquerade he walks up to Queen Imogen and takes her memorial crystal off her. Prepotente is going after him for it. I have no notes on Osvaldo before this moment, which tells you how he has been playing it. I have a note now.
beats.gist: Osvaldo takes Queen Imogen's memorial crystal in the wreck of the Masquerade while Prepotente pursues him.

beats.headline: Number eight
beats.text: New name on the top ten: Osvaldo, number eight, a level-60 Curupira ranger. Neither Crawler Carl nor his guide knows what a Curupira is. He looks human. After Imogen fell, he, a crawler named Burcu and Prepotente fought, while Carl lay unconscious. Burcu is number ten. Osvaldo's hawk, Gimli, was eaten by Bianca at the end of the Masquerade, and he holds the memorial crystal that Carl, and very likely Prepotente, have quests to take from him.
beats.gist: Osvaldo is a level-60 Curupira ranger and number eight on the top ten.

beats.headline: Riding it out in the woods
beats.text: On Boomer's list of crawlers not under the Posse banner: the goat, unaffiliated and hiding his position; Lucia Mar, the same; a crawler named Burcu whose whole team seems to have been taken in by the Madness and has stopped answering; and a handful affiliated with the NPC team. The crawlers the orcs conscripted are all gone. And Osvaldo, the one Carl asked about, is riding it out in the woods with a large group of crawlers who call themselves Team Flamengo.
beats.gist: Osvaldo rides it out in the woods with a large group of crawlers called Team Flamengo.

beats.headline: A giant rainbow in the Madness territory
beats.text: Sighting, Madness territory: a giant rainbow, visible from a very long way off. The rainbow is Apito's memorial crystal, and the hands holding it are Osvaldo's. He is in none of the Faction Wars armies. I did not think that was possible either. The rainbow has just told the Madness army exactly where Crawler Carl's group is standing, and they are calling in Prepotente's forces for backup. Thank you, Osvaldo.
beats.gist: Osvaldo holds Apito's memorial crystal, a giant rainbow that reveals Carl's group to the Madness army.

beats.headline: Team Flamengo joins the heat
beats.text: The heat's newest team is a pair of crawlers on Bruna the Slaughter Gnu: Osvaldo, level seventy-two, a Curupira, with Filipe L at the reins and a dwarf mercenary behind. Both worship Tupa, which rules them out of the Pineapple Cabaret. Crawler Carl messages him a careful list of which teams to leave alone and why. His reply, in full: he is not talking to Carl, he will not attack unless it is them or him, and he does not care about the rest.
beats.gist: Osvaldo is a level seventy-two Curupira on Bruna the Slaughter Gnu who refuses to talk to Carl.

beats.headline: Two crystals, both wrong
beats.text: Asked privately, he answers. His god Tupa wanted a memorial crystal. He took Apito's off Queen Imogen at the moment she died, because otherwise his party would have been smitten, and Tupa said it was corrupted. A second, found in the forest during Faction Wars, was also wrong. He gave the first to Prepotente and was shouted at for not doing it sooner. The second is Ysalte's. Paz was his friend, he adds, and Anton, and Sister Ines. Everyone who meets Carl dies. Now it is their turn, he supposes.
beats.gist: Osvaldo tells Carl that everyone who meets Carl dies.

beats.headline: A second crystal
beats.text: For the record, from Crawler Carl's account in the pet stables: Osvaldo carries a quest from his deity to find out why the memorial crystals are not working, and he holds a second one, also uncharged. The first he handed back to Prepotente, its proper owner, who was, per Princess Donut, mean to him about it. Prepotente's position is that a thief with a change of heart is still a thief. The record supports both parties. Osvaldo is not in the room to comment.
beats.gist: Osvaldo carries a quest from his deity to find why memorial crystals are not working.

beats.headline: Better to die than take a deal
beats.text: Crawler Osvaldo has answered Crawler Carl's messages. They are working together, he says, but they are not friends. His game guide told him never to take a deal on the tenth floor, whatever happens, because it is better to die, and nothing he has seen since argues with it. He and Filipe will take their chances in the seventh heat. Crawler Donut points out that he will die there. Only if he comes in last place, he replies. That is his position, and it is on file.
beats.gist: Osvaldo tells Carl they work together but are not friends and will enter the seventh heat.

beats.headline: Caught on the gate at the portals
beats.text: Crawler Osvaldo has been eliminated. He was speeding for the portals on the roof of the apartment complex when Britney put a stop to it, and she now holds Ysalte's memorial crystal, which he had been carrying. Crawler Carl asked him, right up to the green light, not to force it. He forced it. He declined everything. It is a consistent record.
beats.gist: Britney eliminates Crawler Osvaldo and takes Ysalte's memorial crystal after he forces the portal gate.
